method: Read complete current story including Final Thought and provenance; opened four eligible original photographs, generated provisional model, drawn staging, and all three proposed final images using view_image detail original. Reopened all three final files for a second native-resolution coat/anatomy inspection. Original photos exceeded display size and were displayed resized; every final was displayed at native dimensions. No generation performed.

findings: Neet has a full narrow fawn trunk, fine planted legs, clear belly clearance, broad triangular ears and a tiny rump nub. Buddy has a continuous moderately elongated dark torso, projecting muzzle, hanging furnished ears, visible neck and four substantial planted limbs.

Both dogs have clear separate limb ownership and contact shadows on the same floor plane. The near/far feet and hallway perspective are coherent; the reaching hand meets the bag zipper without crossing a dog.

Heather can reach the nearly closed travel kit while Buddy still occupies its immediate side: the minimal concession gag reads. Neet stands alert behind him. Cropped human appearance remains provisional.

At native 1774x887, the low-contrast irregular interior mottling is nondirectional surface/wash texture, also present in bag, trousers and floor; it does not produce curled strands, raised shag or enlarged coat volume. Smooth nape, back, belly and leg silhouettes remain close. Buddy regional ear/muzzle furnishings remain distinct. No material finish defect found.

Buddy carries the tennis ball firmly at the muzzle while approaching the waiting hand. This is the return BEFORE the subsequent drop, matching the current anchor. Neet watching behind him provides the astonished contrast; school windows, lawn and trees establish the field.

Buddy torso is foreshortened by the approach rather than disconnected or shortened arbitrarily. Two advancing/lifted paws and two ground supports remain traceable to their respective shoulders/hips. The crossed foreground foreleg overlaps rather than fuses with the planted foreleg.

Neet has four separately owned slender legs, a full trunk, large triangular ears and a tiny nub; Buddy retains deep chest, substantial legs, dark throat, pale chest sides and furnished muzzle/brows/ears. His tapering raised tail is continuous with the rump and has no plume.

At native 1448x1086, faint interior texture remains but reads as subdued non-directional painted surface rather than curly coat strands; back, flank and leg contours are close and smooth. Ball contact, shadows and the human hand are coherent. No material defect found.

Buddy sits supported on the rug with two distinct planted forepaws, folded haunches and identifiable rear feet; neck and torso are continuous. His upward gaze fixes on the plate. Neet stands beside him with four fine planted legs and a modest downward head angle that reads as the specified solemn bow.

Neet retains a full narrow fawn torso, cream chest, broad triangular ears, projecting muzzle and visible tiny rump nub. Buddy retains dark torso/throat with pale chest fields, substantial limbs and regional muzzle/brow/ear furnishing. Seated foreshortening does not sever the ribcage or inflate the head.

The plate remains in Heather hands before Neet accepts a portion; the sofa-edge seat and visible balcony glass match the stated scene. One spoon and small golden portions suffice for the offered shared treat; no contradictory object handoff is shown. Warm evening light fits the dinner passage despite its earlier section heading.

At native 1448x1086, low-contrast texture inside the bodies stays subordinate to smooth short-coat shading and close contours. The visible furnished strands are chiefly facial/ear regions; no all-over shag, curled body locks or enlarged fur volume. Hands, plate, sofa and floor support are resolved. No material defect found.

overall_findings: All three pictures offer different narrative contributions: reluctant packing cooperation, surprising ball-return competence, and shared treat anticipation. The remaining low-contrast wash pattern is not judged material coat-length or grooming drift. No open visual correction is required for these pinned versions. Complete illustrated reading is a separate pending stage.
